title: NODE — Ridge East, the Willow That Dreamt the Rain

features.name: the module in the fold of the willow
features.desc-on-touch: It went dark during the storm and came back by itself. Moisture, perhaps, or the wind dislodged it. Nobody drove up to check.

features.name: the outage readings
features.desc-on-touch: It recorded the rainfall while it was out, and the data does not come close to what the other nodes recorded. She said it observed the storm more accurately than any of them.

features.name: what it said when it woke
features.desc-on-touch: It is like the module went to sleep, had a dream about the rain, and then told you all about it.

features.name: tennis courts, out of use since last century
features.desc-on-touch: A network of them below the peak, lines still holding their rectangles. The willow has been looking at them the whole time.

inscription: it reads like a different language

file.name: RidgeEast_Rainfall_dreamt.csv
file.note: Readings logged during an outage. Every column is populated. No unit matches.
